scope.authorization: Root explicitly approved dedicated new jobs resource scope for the new read-only provider ledger. Existing arbitrary-string key schema and requireScope mechanism remain unchanged. sessions/keys privileges are not expanded.
scope.keyIssuance: Existing POST /keys accepts any nonempty array of string scopes under keys permission; no key was minted. Existing Settings checkbox choices omit jobs and require central integration.

proposedQuery.limitSyntax: one scalar ASCII decimal matching ^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$ and numeric range 1..100
proposedQuery.invalidBehavior: 400 fixed error; reject duplicate, array/object, unknown keys and every tenant selector; no dependency call

proposedRead.tenant: only verified req.auth.tenantId; never URL/body/header tenant selector
proposedRead.database: existing @lkb/db application database only; dedicated UPLOAD_QUEUE_DB excluded
proposedRead.truncated: observed extra result exists; no count claim about all records
proposedRead.projection: explicit whitelisted fields only; both DB projection and defensive HTTP projection
proposedRead.malformedRecord: generic503, never silently label healthy or serialize raw row
proposedRead.statusSemantics: provider-call audit entries; not end-to-end pipeline completion, aggregate cost or upload queue status
proposedRead.scope: requireScope("jobs") after existing requireAuth and rate limiter

constraints: Root may dispatch implementation under approved dedicated jobs scope and machine spec; only independent checker can PASS
Do not edit schemas, frozen contracts, auth helper, Ask, upload worker, Meet, Sources explorer or existing session/dashboard pages
No DB, provider, browser, full suite, deployment or production changes in planning

frontendIsolation.keyChange: Immediately reset rows, loading/error and local stale-result generation on key change/logout. Late previous-key success or rejection cannot render under replacement key.
frontendIsolation.responseValidation: Refuse malformed jobs/limit/truncated or whitelisted summary shapes, unknown statuses and poisoned extra properties; no silent partial success.
frontendIsolation.errors: Fixed sanitized UI errors; never display a key string or backend raw error.
frontendIsolation.sourceLabel: Application provider-audit records only; not dedicated upload queue or generalized pipeline completion.

builderInterfaces.dbAccessor: jobs(tenantId:string) wrapping scopedCollection<Jobs>; single integrator exports barrel
builderInterfaces.storeContract: createMongoJobsReadDeps(reader=jobs): JobsReadDeps; bounds limit before query; scoped find with explicit projection/sort/limit+1; validate/project result; test injected fake cursor without DB
